The Fed raised rates 25bp on Sep 17 to 3.75-4.00% and holds its next meeting Oct 27-28. A hot CPI today keeps open the possibility of another hike or a prolonged hold at elevated rates. The S&P 500 forward P/E is roughly 20x (near 5-year average) but CAPE is near 41.6 (historically extreme). SPY is above its 200-day average, confirming a technical uptrend, but the macro backdrop — reaccelerating inflation, rising rates, and more data-heavy days ahead — supports demanding a full margin of safety. Posture: cautious.
